q1_issues.issue: The indefinite subject of a copular predication is encoded as an existential witness (an individual with Member), whereas the instruction set makes "a/an" generic in a copular predication — a kind-level Inheritance claim at the empirical bare-generic truth value, not an individual at 1.0/0.99.

q2_gaps: predicative adjective with a respect/dimension PP ("big in size") — Measure needs a magnitude and unit, and the preposition-named oblique is defined for events/claims, so there is no licensed place for "in size" on a flat copular atom
notes: "in size" is silently dropped; it is semantically near-vacuous here, but the instruction set gives no form for it either way.
